summary: community.postgresql changes: the db alias in postgresql_info and postgresql_user is deprecated (use login_db), and postgresql_pg_hba keep_comments_at_rules no longer does anything (comments stay with rules) and will be removed in 5.0.0.
questions: Does keep_comments_at_rules still work in postgresql_pg_hba?
What argument replaces db in postgresql_user?

answer_card.title: postgresql_info, user and pg_hba changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `postgresql_info` / `postgresql_user`: the `db` alias is deprecated. Use `login_db`.
- `postgresql_pg_hba`: `keep_comments_at_rules` now does nothing, because comments are kept with their rules by default. It will be removed in 5.0.0.
